### Triumphal Procession in Christ
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/triumphal-procession-in-christ
Passage: 2 Corinthians 2:12-14
Points:
- Despite pastoral anxiety and travel disruptions in Troas, Paul paused to thank God for sovereign gospel victory.
- Paul drew upon the Roman military practice of marching captives through cities while dispersing incense.
- Believers represent Christ's prize won at the cross rather than willing captives of Satan.
- Christians are called to spread the pleasing knowledge of Christ everywhere they go.
- Sharing the gospel and supporting the church allows believers to participate in Christ's ongoing procession.

### The Aroma of Christ
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-aroma-of-christ-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 2:14-16
Points:
- The physical sense of smell can turn our attention toward God in gratitude and awe.
- Christians become the pleasing fragrance of Christ by pursuing holiness and walking in selfless love.
- Just as incense accompanied prayer and sacrifice in Scripture, our devotion rises favorably before God.
- Daily prayer and intentional obedience allow believers to project Christ's spiritual character.
- Living out the aroma of Christ points others toward the sweetness of relationship with Him.
